announcements.title: Doğum gününde 24 saat Premium hediye! 🎂
announcements.content: Kaynaklar&Ayarlar bölümünden doğum gününü kaydet, o gün Premium avantajlarını keşfet.
announcements.title_en: 🎂 Enjoy 24 hours of Premium on your birthday!
announcements.content_en: Go to Sources → Settings and save your birthday to unlock Premium benefits on your special day.
announcements.title_de: 🎂 Genieße 24 Stunden Premium an deinem Geburtstag!
announcements.content_de: Speichere deinen Geburtstag unter Quellen → Einstellungen und entdecke an deinem Ehrentag die Premium-Vorteile.
